title: Commerce Interface & Product Discovery
description: Developing a responsive commerce interface where product discovery, categorization and clear purchase actions work together.
question: How can an online catalogue make product comparison and action easy without overwhelming visitors?
design: Designed a product-card system with clear grouping, imagery, pricing, and accessible action affordances. The portfolio image is a cropped real catalogue interface rather than an advertisement for the original store.
reflection: Commercial interfaces should make products easier to evaluate, not simply fill the page with buttons.
coverAlt: Cropped real commerce product-card screenshot showing product photographs, titles, prices and calls to action without the business header
